 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Coach Michael Kohlmann has named Alexander Zverev to his Germany squad for the Davis Cup finals in Bologna, the German Tennis Federation (DTB) said on Instagram on Monday.
 Jan-Lennard Struff and doubles pair Kevin Krawietz and Tim Pütz were also nominated to the squad.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The final eight of the Davis Cup will take place on November 24-29 and Germany are bidding for a first title since 1993.
 Zverev is the biggest star of the team. This season, he won his first Grand Slam at the French Open and topped that up with the US Open win. He has also secured year-end number one on the men's ATP rankings.
 "We have a strong team with great quality, a lot of experience, and players who can handle pressure. With Sascha (Zverev), we have the best player in the world right now in our ranks," Kohlmann said.
 "The fact that Sascha wants to play for Germany again despite his gruelling season is not a given and shows how important the team is to him."
 Germany start the final eight against Britain on November 26.
